form.title: About Your Field
form.machineAccess: Access to DSR seed drill machine?
form.herbicideWithin24h: Can spray weedicide within 24 hours of sowing?
form.salinity: Saline / Kallar soil or brackish tubewell water?
result.awdNote: AWD on transplanted paddy needs no machine and no herbicide program; consider this first.
warning.saline_no_awd: Saline soil or water detected: AWD (alternate drying) is not recommended as it concentrates salts. Keep soil consistently moist.
warning.flowering_never_dry: Flowering Stage: Never let the field dry! Maintain 2-3 inches of standing water to prevent empty grains.
warning.stage_approximate: Variety stage boundaries are approximate. Check plant progress visually.
warning.season_early_sowing: Warning: Entered date is before the official recommended transplanting window for your district.
reason.prev_crop_non_rice: High risk of iron deficiency and severe weeds when DSR follows non-rice crops like cotton, maize, or sugarcane.
reason.not_levelled: Field is not laser-levelled. Uneven water depth leads to poor weed control in DSR.
reason.no_machine: Proper seed-cum-fertilizer drill with press wheels is required for uniform DSR germination.
reason.herbicide_timing: Applying herbicide within 24 hours of DSR sowing is mandatory for weed suppression.
reason.weed_history: Heavy weed history makes DSR weed control very risky and expensive.
reason.saline_or_unknown: Saline or sodic soil is unsuitable for DSR; crop establishment often fails.
cost.title: Per-Acre Cost Comparison
cost.breakEvenText: DSR is cheaper unless it yields {loss} quintals less per acre.
